userDirection.interpretation: Approve the V11 lava-material direction and continue bounded surface-motion, heat-lighting and performance refinement without reopening the city geometry.

baseline.reason: V11's fresh runtime capture is still unavailable, so V12 is an implementation continuation rather than a visually scored promotion.

changes: Added two-frequency normal-direction displacement to the authored horizontal canals and gravity-facing falls.
Replaced the magma-sea triangle fan with a quality-scaled grid so the molten surface can physically move rather than only scroll color.
Derived changing magma-sea normals from the wave slopes for camera- and light-responsive surface breakup.
Preserved the irregular molten-sea silhouette with a shader boundary mask.
Added small deterministic drift to the four localized canal heat lights so hot reflections travel across nearby masonry.
Scaled FBM compilation cost to four octaves on High, three on Medium and two on Low.
Kept reduced-motion output deterministic for displacement, shader advection and thermal lights.

runtimeEvidence.reason: The local browser automation boundary remains unavailable. No visual score or approval is inferred from source code and static tests.

decision.nextAction: Inspect the live V12 overview and moving lava on the existing local preview. When capture authority is available, record fixed overview, survey and weak-side orbit evidence before visual promotion.
